summary: Tested Fee Receipt PDF + Overdue-alert flag flow end-to-end for SV Group admissions console. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (auth login+cookies, fixture SVN-202609-DDF7 exists with schedule 'First' due 2026-09-29, receipt_no format SVR-XXXX-XXXXXX enforced on new payments and stable across reads, PDF endpoint returns application/pdf %PDF magic + correct Content-Disposition, unauthenticated request rejected with 401, /payments POST assigns receipt_no and the just-created receipt is downloadable). Frontend: login → red overdue-alert-card on dashboard with '1 student · ₹50,000' + working link to /admin/students; students list shows students-overdue-banner and students-row-overdue-SVN-202609-DDF7 badge '1 overdue · ₹ 50,000'; student detail /admin/students/SVN-202609-DDF7 shows overdue-banner, 4 payment rows each render receipt-no (SVR-DDF7-*) + working FileDown icon that triggers a real browser download of a valid PDF (Receipt-SVR-DDF7-E11705.pdf, magic %PDF) without blanking the page; Log Payment inline form adds a new payment with a fresh SVR- receipt-no; dashboard inline payment on the applications row (payment-amount-input / payment-submit-button) recorded ₹100 and Collected updated from ₹1,00,500 → ₹1,00,600; WhatsApp reminder link (overdue-send-reminder-button) still opens https://wa.me/... with pre-filled text. Regression: /, /apply, /admin/students, /admin/students/:id render at 1920px and 390px mobile, no page errors.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option> due to Emergent code-editor overlay attributes (x-source-var / x-excluded). Not application code; will not appear in prod build but noisy in console during testing.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/applications/{id} uses Mongo _id but the app number is stored in application_number; only /applications/by-number/{n} resolves the human ID. Frontend already uses by-number, but tests/scripts referencing 'application_id = SVN-...' will 404 unless resolved first. Consider accepting either _id or application_number in the by-id route for consistency.
AdminPage.jsx is 763 lines and StudentDetailPage.jsx is 531 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting payment form / schedule form / modal into separate components.

The bulk 'log payment' inline row on the dashboard does not display the new receipt_no anywhere in the row (only Collected total is updated). Not a bug per spec but a discoverability gap — consider a toast showing the receipt no. after inline submission.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing fixture SVN-202609-DDF7 (Sreehari Anish). Cleanup of one UI-added ₹500 TEST_ui_add payment may not have completed — verify next run and remove if lingering. Dashboard inline test added ₹100 (not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses _id (uuid hex) as application id in path params; always resolve via GET /api/applications/by-number/{app_number} first. Login returns access_token in body AND sets httpOnly cookies; either works. Fixture SVN-202609-DDF7 now has 5-6 payments (originals + a ₹500 UI test + ₹100 dashboard-inline test) — treat all as fixture data. pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope, use `-n 0` to serialize; `-p no:xdist` errors.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failures were fixture-related (test used application_number in a path that expects the internal _id, and used 'fee_schedules' where the model exposes 'schedules'); tests corrected.
